costBasis: Per-instance cost averaged within each scenario, then across the four scenarios; not actual billing

instanceCost.deepseek: Benchmark instance cost.usd: per-request official price list, peak / off-peak by request time
instanceCost.anthropic: Benchmark instance cost.usd: Claude Code total_cost_usd, API-equivalent USD on a subscription run
instanceCost.openai: Token counts priced at the rates below; the benchmark ran on a ChatGPT plan, so this is a reference API price
instanceCost.strata: Local running cost from the instance work seconds and the localRunningCost settings below

strata-iq3_xxs.notes: Home PC with an RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB, i9-13900 and 64 GB RAM. 400 W is a rough whole-system load estimate (350 W GPU board limit; memory-bound decoding usually draws less). Electricity is the Q1 2026 world household average (country-weighted). Maintenance covers wear parts at about USD 50 a year over about 2,500 loaded hours.
